fonts.note: Informal, slightly irregular humanist face like Andy Bold; Comic Sans MS has a similar casual weight and ships with Windows.
Brush-style display face; Segoe Print is the closest hand-drawn face that ships with Windows 10 and 11.
Light humanist sans; Trebuchet MS has similar proportions and a friendly shape.
Thin handwriting script; Segoe Script is a connected hand and ships with Windows.
Humanist sans from the same Ascender family style as Segoe UI; widths are close.
Wide geometric sans in several weights; Arial gives similar widths in Regular and Bold.
Wide, technical italic display face; use Arial with the Italic style for a similar look.
Grotesque sans in the Franklin and Helvetica tradition; Arial is the nearest face on every Windows install.
Small-capital Roman display serif; Georgia is a serif with open, readable forms. Pericles draws lowercase as small capitals, so text will look different.
Old-style serif; Georgia is a close match in color and proportion.
Segmented digital-clock face; Consolas is monospaced and keeps digit widths even.
Draws each letter inside a keycap box; no Windows font does this, so Segoe UI keeps the glyph set but loses the boxes.
Monospaced Segoe design; Consolas is monospaced and ships with Windows. Segoe UI is not monospaced and would change column layouts.
Geometric humanist sans; Trebuchet MS has similar widths and letter shapes.
